about_the_game:
Step back into the age of honour and conquest with the Knights Character Pack! Unlock five new medieval-themed characters and reclaim the streets by planting your flags of victory.

Take command of the legendary King Richard and his valiant Crusader Knights, or lead the charge as the fearless Queen Boudica. Defend your honor with the noble Saint George, or bring divine strength to the battlefield with his devoted Hieromonk.

Thank you for supporting the project — your courage keeps the legend alive!
